confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Lima prices; no live listings or booking pages were inspected. Beer and restaurant anchors are the most reliable; accommodation varies widely by district and season. Cocktail and wine were set from the local price relationship to beer (pisco sour about 2x beer, wine glass about 1.7x beer) because direct knowledge is weaker. FX reading (2026-10-14, 0.7002 USD per AUD) came from a search-result excerpt of the RBA homepage, not the RBA F11.1 table, and no 15 October reading was found.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: general Latin American capital-city tourist pricing, using Lima's own sol price levels; no single named comparable city was used.
